hero.title: Grab × Navier — the black-car network, on the water
hero.subtitle: Southeast Asia's super-app already owns the demand. Water is the only transport surface no one owns yet.
hero.what_we_do_together: We launch a Grab-branded foiling water tier across Southeast Asia's densest coastal corridors — booked in-app, premium-priced, region-wide and category-defining. Navier brings the software-defined hydrofoiling fleet and the network playbook now proven in the Maldives; Grab brings the demand, the app, and the regional reach. Together we turn slow, weather-exposed ferry crossings into fast, smooth, on-demand water trips — and claim the category before anyone else does.

why_now: Foiling lifts the hull clear of the water: faster, dramatically more efficient per passenger-mile, smooth and near-silent, hybrid-capable with no charging-infrastructure dependency, and autonomy-ready. A ~100-vessel network is already ramping in the Maldives (Bloomberg/WSJ, 2026). The category gets claimed cluster-by-cluster — and Southeast Asia's cross-border seas are the next surface.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Singapore beachhead
phases.narrative: We launch with five Pioneer II vessels on Singapore's three highest-demand water corridors — proving the in-app water tier in the world's busiest port, where the regulator is already mandating clean harbour craft. Small fleet, dense utilisation, a clean first-of-class story.

phases.label: Phase 2 — Singapore full network + cross-border
featured_routes: Singapore ↔ Batam & Bintan — full cross-border Riau network
Marina Bay ↔ Sentosa ↔ Southern Islands — full inner mesh
CBD ↔ Riau resorts & marinas — corporate shuttle
phases.narrative: We scale the fleet and light up the full Singapore network — the complete inner waterfront mesh plus the cross-border Riau corridor that millions already cross by slow ferry every year. This is where the unit economics and the cross-border demand story compound.

phases.label: Phase 3 — Regional expansion: Bali & Phuket
featured_routes: Bali ↔ Lombok ↔ Komodo — luxury island-hopping chain
phases.narrative: With Singapore proven, we replicate the playbook in the next two highest-value SEA island clusters: Bali (gateway to the Lombok–Komodo luxury chain) and Phuket (the Andaman hub). Three clusters, one app, one region-wide water network — the foundation for all of Southeast Asia.

close.title: One app. One region-wide water network. The whole region next.
close.body: Singapore proves it, the Riau crossing scales it, and Bali + Phuket make it regional. From there the same playbook extends across every coastal market Grab already serves — the water layer of Southeast Asia's super-app.
